mission.statement: A local, single-user interview-preparation tutor that may assert only what the corpus in front of it says; grounding is enforced by construction.

deliverables.name: gap list the candidate decides
deliverables.oracle_command: diagnose.is_approved refuses while any gap is proposed (prepwright/diagnose.py:576)

deliverables.name: provenanced source documents
deliverables.oracle_command: doc table CHECK constraints + hash columns

deliverables.name: a grounded teaching turn
deliverables.oracle_command: cites checked against build_pack; invented tokens surfaced

steps.name: capture posting (URL, paste, or application-folder import)

side_effects.what: creates a new track db + library row

steps.oracle: parse_posting_page returns confident:false with a paste instruction when no body found

steps.name: derive probes and propose gaps from posting + resume claims
steps.oracle: probe_plan reserves a resume-side share; verdicts_without_a_model never awards solid

steps.name: candidate decides every gap
steps.oracle: is_approved false while any gap is proposed or list empty

steps.name: fetch approved sources into the corpus
steps.oracle: SSRF guard refuses non-global addresses per hop; sha256 + byte caps recorded

steps.name: plan steps by dependency and pin section slices
steps.oracle: check_gaps refuses before any write; defers gaps no source covers

steps.name: one grounded teaching turn

side_effects.what: append-only turn rows, deduped by client seq

can_retry_on: CLI timeout with no turn appended
steps.oracle: cites validated against the pack; invented citations surfaced in the footer; refusal over invention

steps.name: advisory assessment/review
can_retry_on: CLI timeout with no row appended
steps.oracle: schema-validated output; advisory only - the candidate ticks a step off, not the grader

steps.name: boot-time integrity + recovery ladder

side_effects.what: rung 6+ may discard content under real pressure; rung 9 stops for a human

steps.oracle: manifest verify names the tampered file and exits 1

transitions.condition: gaps exist and not all decided
summary.decided true and no ready docs
ready docs exist and no steps

fields.item: per-track store: intake, gaps, docs, sections, steps, slices, turns, assessments

durable_state.retention: append-only; nothing shrinks; trash + quarantine ladders in keep.py

loops.oracle: grounding check per turn; the candidate ends the session
loops.bound: none:attended single-user chat, ended by the human, byte caps counted in the causing write

never_do.rule: No pip, no dependency. Standard library only.
No API key anywhere; chat runs through the owner's logged-in claude/codex CLI.
Do not rename tutor/student/candidate/step/session/assessment/recap/transcript/track/stage/corpus/citation; X-Tutor-Bridge, TUTOR_TS_* and STEP_KEY_RE are two-sided contracts.
The tutor may assert only what the corpus in front of it says; enforced by construction.
Nothing shrinks: turn/mark/assessment/card_review/gap_history/track_history raise ABORT on DELETE and on UPDATE outside one receipted case.
Suite must pass offline on system 3.9.6 and Homebrew 3.14 under -I -S.

subgraph_boundaries: one database per track; open_track() is the only connector; composite FK cannot cross files

cost_latency.runs_per_day: a handful; single owner preparing for one interview

figures.source: estimate: subprocess round-trip, not timed this session

fixtures: tests/ Base.a_track helpers; live-bridge HTTP tests in tests/test_pipeline_routes.py

pii_fields: the owner's resume, fit report, and application folder under intake/
secrets_locations: none in-app by design; provider auth lives in the owner's claude CLI session
data_boundaries.redaction_rules: corpus.redact() on everything routed through intake; NO_ERRANDS guardrails in the tutor system prompt; the CLI is invoked with no tools

run_artifacts.layout: ~/.prepwright/ store; qa evidence in tests/; MANIFEST.sha256 pins 19 runtime files
run_artifacts.immutability_rules: append-only triggers; recovery verifies before it overwrites

orchestration_today.who_decides_transitions: deterministic code: flow_state derives the stage from facts on disk; each route refuses when its precondition is unmet; the model never picks a step
orchestration_today.persistence: append-only SQLite per track, WAL, byte caps counted in the causing write
orchestration_today.resume: every HTTP request is short-lived; state at rest resumes by construction; delta protocol means a stale tab cannot express a loss
orchestration_today.observability: structured store rows + page rendering of grounding fields; launcher verifies the manifest

model_gate.topology: none: a single local process; deterministic pipeline with at most one bounded, schema-shaped model call per user action (teach, assess, judge, and the planned source-proposal call)
model_gate.source: inline (agent-orchestration Steps 0-1 answered from dossier rows; skill not invoked)

what_it_costs: adding langgraph would violate never_do n_stdlib (pip dependency) and pull langchain-core; langchain-anthropic expects an API key, violating n_apikey

loop_controls.stop_predicate: teach loop: the candidate ends the session; source-discovery loop (planned): doc stored and covers the gap terms, or proposal rounds exhausted
loop_controls.effort_floor: one proposal round per uncovered gap
loop_controls.effort_ceiling: MAX_RESEARCH_URLS=12 per run, RESEARCH_BUDGET_SECONDS=100, at most 2 proposal rounds per gap (planned)
locked_surface: grounding: build_pack is the only prompt source of corpus bytes
loop_controls.rollback: quarantine/trash ladders in keep.py; docs can be quarantined, never silently rewritten
loop_controls.recursion_limit: n/a: no graph; bounds are plain-code constants
loop_controls.source: inline (agent-orchestration Step 3 answered from loops[], never_do[], run_artifacts)

open_questions: Source-discovery autonomy: the owner has directed that the app finds reliable teaching sources itself; does the owner want a visible source ledger with remove/quarantine controls in the UI (recommended), given per-source pre-approval is no longer required?
Will the owner answer the ~20 diagnostic probes so the plan shortens, or accept the maximal plan?
